descriptionEn: Implanted dose, depth distribution, lattice damage and electrical activation are different variables; epitaxy and implantation are alternative or combined integration branches. steps.title: 延伸接面剖面建模

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate model extension-junction profiles by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較淺接面濃度剖面與通道邊界。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare shallow dopant profiles with the channel boundary. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

knowledge.text: 佈植劑量、深度分佈、晶格損傷與電性活化是不同變量；外延與佈植屬可替代或組合的整合分支。 本題具體操作為「比對佈植前後光阻輪廓影像」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Implanted dose, depth distribution, lattice damage and electrical activation are different variables; epitaxy and implantation are alternative or combined integration branches. Here the concrete task is: Compare resist profiles before and after model implantation. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 光阻熱負載判讀的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess resist thermal loading
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「遮罩邊緣未塌陷或產生顯著退縮」。但熱退縮會改變實際阻擋範圍；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Mask edges show no collapse or marked recession. However, thermal recession changes the effective blocked region; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「光阻熱負載判讀」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for assess resist thermal loading?
options: 遮罩邊緣未塌陷或產生顯著退縮
外延界面具有可追溯的潔淨證據
空間電性變化可與熱場交叉檢查
optionsEn: Mask edges show no collapse or marked recession
The epitaxial interface has traceable cleanliness evidence
Spatial electrical variation can be cross-checked against the thermal field
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比對佈植前後光阻輪廓影像」，因此直接證據是「遮罩邊緣未塌陷或產生顯著退縮」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：熱退縮會改變實際阻擋範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare resist profiles before and after model implantation; the direct criterion is: Mask edges show no collapse or marked recession. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Thermal recession changes the effective blocked region.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate evaluate pre-amorphization by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: locate the amorphous layer relative to the intended junction.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，標示示意非晶層與預定接面的位置。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, locate the amorphous layer relative to the intended junction. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：非晶化範圍與後續再結晶需求相容。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: amorphized depth is compatible with recrystallization needs. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：過深損傷可能增加接面附近缺陷。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Excess depth can add defects near the junction. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「底部與側壁均有連續覆蓋」。但頂部成膜正常不保證孔底連續；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Both bottom and sidewalls have continuous coverage. However, good top coverage does not guarantee bottom continuity; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「接觸襯層底部覆蓋」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for inspect contact-liner bottom coverage?
options: 底部與側壁均有連續覆蓋
接觸貢獻不被長引線電阻混淆
矽化物僅在指定矽接觸區形成
optionsEn: Both bottom and sidewalls have continuous coverage
Lead resistance does not confound the contact contribution
Silicide forms only at intended silicon contacts
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「在高深寬比孔截面追蹤襯層連續性」，因此直接證據是「底部與側壁均有連續覆蓋」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：頂部成膜正常不保證孔底連續。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to trace liner continuity in high-aspect-ratio contacts; the direct criterion is: Both bottom and sidewalls have continuous coverage. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Good top coverage does not guarantee bottom continuity.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate verify contact-barrier integrity by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare barrier sections with elemental diffusion evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare barrier sections with elemental diffusion evidence. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：導體元素未出現非預期越界分佈。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: conductor species show no unintended boundary crossing. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：針孔可能讓局部擴散被平均量測漏掉。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: pinholes can permit diffusion hidden by averages. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.

steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Conductor species show no unintended boundary crossing. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Pinholes can permit diffusion hidden by averages. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate map interlayer dielectric gaps by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: measure conductor spacing and gap aspect ratios.

steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, measure conductor spacing and gap aspect ratios. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：最狹窄區與最深區皆列入填充評估。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: both narrowest and deepest regions enter the fill assessment. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：只檢查開闊區會漏掉窄縫風險。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

knowledge.textEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. knowledge.text: 介電膜必須同時提供隔離、機械支撐與可加工性；CMP 的去除速率與圖形密度、膜材及接觸狀態相互耦合。 本題具體操作為「比較乾燥與吸濕樣本的光學及電性」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. Here the concrete task is: Compare optical and electrical data for dry and humid samples. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 吸濕後膜性質漂移的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess moisture-induced film drift
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「環境歷程與膜性質變化可追溯」。但將吸水漂移當成沉積漂移會誤修機台；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Environmental history tracks property changes. However, misreading moisture drift can prompt an incorrect tool adjustment; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

邊緣模型與可用晶粒範圍相符
optionsEn: Particles decrease without added fragile-film damage
Environmental history tracks property changes
The edge model matches the usable die region
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較乾燥與吸濕樣本的光學及電性」，因此直接證據是「環境歷程與膜性質變化可追溯」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：將吸水漂移當成沉積漂移會誤修機台。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare optical and electrical data for dry and humid samples; the direct criterion is: Environmental history tracks property changes. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.

steps.failure: 診斷提醒：未知初始階差會誤導終點判斷。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。

knowledge.text: 介電膜必須同時提供隔離、機械支撐與可加工性；CMP 的去除速率與圖形密度、膜材及接觸狀態相互耦合。 本題具體操作為「分辨環狀水痕與研磨殘粒形貌」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Dielectrics provide isolation, mechanical support and process compatibility; CMP removal couples material, pattern density and pad contact. Here the concrete task is: Distinguish ring-shaped drying marks from CMP particles. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 乾燥水痕辨識的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for identify post-clean drying marks
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「污染形貌與乾燥位置具有一致關聯」。但水痕可能被誤判為原始沉積缺陷；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Residue morphology correlates with drying locations. However, drying marks may be mistaken for deposition defects; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「乾燥水痕辨識」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for identify post-clean drying marks?
options: 污染形貌與乾燥位置具有一致關聯
膜質判讀不僅依賴沉積厚度
待去除高度與保留層位置清楚分離
optionsEn: Residue morphology correlates with drying locations
Film quality is assessed beyond deposited thickness
Removal height is separated from layers that must remain
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「分辨環狀水痕與研磨殘粒形貌」，因此直接證據是「污染形貌與乾燥位置具有一致關聯」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：水痕可能被誤判為原始沉積缺陷。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to distinguish ring-shaped drying marks from CMP particles; the direct criterion is: Residue morphology correlates with drying locations. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Drying marks may be mistaken for deposition defects.

steps.title: 平坦化後膜厚閉合
steps.objective: 完成「平坦化後膜厚閉合」的證據判讀，辨識『對照初始膜厚、去除量與最終殘膜』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate close the post-cmp thickness balance by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare initial film, removed amount and final residual film.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，對照初始膜厚、去除量與最終殘膜。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare initial film, removed amount and final residual film. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：三者在量測不確定度內相互一致。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the three quantities agree within measurement uncertainty. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：不閉合提示量測模型或材料變化。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: nonclosure suggests model error or material change. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「三者在量測不確定度內相互一致」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「不閉合提示量測模型或材料變化」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: The three quantities agree within measurement uncertainty. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Nonclosure suggests model error or material change. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

title: 鑲嵌式互連圖形與蝕刻
description: 鑲嵌互連先在介電層形成溝槽或導通孔，再填入導體；先孔後槽、先槽後孔及其他整合路線的順序不可任意混接。 本模組以示意模型、截面判讀及量測資料完成教學任務；此順序為學習編排，不是可直接執行的晶圓製造行程。
descriptionEn: Damascene forms trenches or vias in dielectric before conductor fill; via-first, trench-first and other integration routes cannot be combined arbitrarily. Exercises use models, cross sections and measurement datasets. The ordering is pedagogical, not an executable wafer traveler.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate select a trench-first branch by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: arrange alignment and bottom opening in a trench-first model.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，排列先槽後孔的對準與底部開口步驟。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, arrange alignment and bottom opening in a trench-first model. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：導通孔落在已定義溝槽的允許區。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: vias land within the permitted trench region. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：套刻裕量不足可能造成孔槽失配。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: insufficient overlay margin can misregister trench and via. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「導通孔落在已定義溝槽的允許區」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「套刻裕量不足可能造成孔槽失配」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Vias land within the permitted trench region. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Insufficient overlay margin can misregister trench and via. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: 先槽後孔路線選擇的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of select a trench-first branch
knowledge.text: 鑲嵌互連先在介電層形成溝槽或導通孔，再填入導體；先孔後槽、先槽後孔及其他整合路線的順序不可任意混接。 本題具體操作為「排列先槽後孔的對準與底部開口步驟」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Damascene forms trenches or vias in dielectric before conductor fill; via-first, trench-first and other integration routes cannot be combined arbitrarily. Here the concrete task is: Arrange alignment and bottom opening in a trench-first model. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 先槽後孔路線選擇的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for select a trench-first branch
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「導通孔落在已定義溝槽的允許區」。但套刻裕量不足可能造成孔槽失配；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Vias land within the permitted trench region. However, insufficient overlay margin can misregister trench and via; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「先槽後孔路線選擇」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for select a trench-first branch?
options: 孔底可達性與預定填充方式相容
遮罩在溝槽成形前仍保有完整性
導通孔落在已定義溝槽的允許區
optionsEn: Bottom accessibility is compatible with intended filling
The mask remains intact until trench formation completes
Vias land within the permitted trench region
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「排列先槽後孔的對準與底部開口步驟」，因此直接證據是「導通孔落在已定義溝槽的允許區」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：套刻裕量不足可能造成孔槽失配。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to arrange alignment and bottom opening in a trench-first model; the direct criterion is: Vias land within the permitted trench region. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Insufficient overlay margin can misregister trench and via.

knowledge.text: 細互連的有效導體截面受阻障與襯層占比影響；成核、填充、退火與研磨需以導通、隔離及可靠度共同驗證。 本題具體操作為「比較加速、抑制與整平作用的示意響應」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Barrier and liner fractions reduce the conducting cross-section of narrow wires; nucleation, filling, annealing and polishing require joint electrical and reliability checks. Here the concrete task is: Compare accelerator, suppressor and leveler responses. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 電鍍液添加劑平衡的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for assess plating-additive balance
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「底部增長與孔口抑制能在模型中共存」。但單看總沉積量會漏判添加劑失衡；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: The model supports bottom growth and opening suppression together. However, total deposition can hide additive imbalance; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「電鍍液添加劑平衡」這一道教學工序的判定？

底部增長與孔口抑制能在模型中共存
空洞位置與可能導通瓶頸相對應
optionsEn: High-current regions match geometric constrictions
The model supports bottom growth and opening suppression together
Void locations match potential conduction bottlenecks
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較加速、抑制與整平作用的示意響應」，因此直接證據是「底部增長與孔口抑制能在模型中共存」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：單看總沉積量會漏判添加劑失衡。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to compare accelerator, suppressor and leveler responses; the direct criterion is: The model supports bottom growth and opening suppression together. steps.title: 電鍍潤濕與困氣
steps.titleEn: Assess plating wetting and trapped gas
steps.objective: 完成「電鍍潤濕與困氣」的證據判讀，辨識『檢查孔內液體進入與氣泡遮蔽示意』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess plating wetting and trapped gas by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: inspect liquid access and bubble masking within cavities.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，檢查孔內液體進入與氣泡遮蔽示意。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, inspect liquid access and bubble masking within cavities. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：待鍍表面可被連續電解液接觸。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: electrolyte continuously contacts the intended plating surface. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：困氣會造成局部無沉積區。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: trapped gas causes local nondeposition. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「待鍍表面可被連續電解液接觸」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「困氣會造成局部無沉積區」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Electrolyte continuously contacts the intended plating surface. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Trapped gas causes local nondeposition. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate map backside cleaning particles by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: separate grinding debris from foreign-particle patterns.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，區分研磨碎屑與外來粒子分佈。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, separate grinding debris from foreign-particle patterns. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：背面殘粒降低且正面未新增污染。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: backside particles decrease without new frontside contamination. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：共用清洗路徑可能轉移污染。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: shared cleaning paths can transfer contamination. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「背面殘粒降低且正面未新增污染」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「共用清洗路徑可能轉移污染」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Backside particles decrease without new frontside contamination. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Shared cleaning paths can transfer contamination. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: 背面清潔粒子圖的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of map backside cleaning particles
knowledge.text: 鈍化保護與薄化支撐要一起設計；晶圓厚度、殘餘損傷、翹曲與後續封裝介面是不同放行項。 本題具體操作為「區分研磨碎屑與外來粒子分佈」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Passivation protection and thinning support are designed together; thickness, residual damage, bow and packaging interfaces require separate acceptance evidence. Here the concrete task is: Separate grinding debris from foreign-particle patterns. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 背面清潔粒子圖的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for map backside cleaning particles
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「背面殘粒降低且正面未新增污染」。但共用清洗路徑可能轉移污染；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Backside particles decrease without new frontside contamination. However, shared cleaning paths can transfer contamination; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「背面清潔粒子圖」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for map backside cleaning particles?
options: 背面殘粒降低且正面未新增污染
連續阻隔路徑覆蓋需保護區
收縮後形貌仍符合介面需求
optionsEn: Backside particles decrease without new frontside contamination
A continuous barrier covers protected regions
Post-cure geometry still satisfies interface requirements
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「區分研磨碎屑與外來粒子分佈」，因此直接證據是「背面殘粒降低且正面未新增污染」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：共用清洗路徑可能轉移污染。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to separate grinding debris from foreign-particle patterns; the direct criterion is: Backside particles decrease without new frontside contamination. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Shared cleaning paths can transfer contamination.

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「電性擷取時溫度已達題定穩態」。但未穩態測試會混入溫漂；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。

optionsEn: Model validity and intercept uncertainty are documented

Transconductance interpretation retains geometry and resistance caveats
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「比較載台設定、實測與晶粒電性時間序列」，因此直接證據是「電性擷取時溫度已達題定穩態」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：未穩態測試會混入溫漂。

steps.title: 低電流守護與遮蔽
steps.objective: 完成「低電流守護與遮蔽」的證據判讀，辨識『比較守護接法前後的空載漏電』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess guarding and shielding by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare open-circuit leakage with and without guarding.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較守護接法前後的空載漏電。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare open-circuit leakage with and without guarding. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：背景漏電小於要辨識的元件訊號。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: background leakage is below the device signal of interest. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：量測線路漏電可能高於元件漏電。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: fixture leakage can exceed device leakage. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「背景漏電小於要辨識的元件訊號」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「量測線路漏電可能高於元件漏電」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Background leakage is below the device signal of interest. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Fixture leakage can exceed device leakage. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

Here the concrete task is: Compare open-circuit leakage with and without guarding. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.text: 電性量測必須控制接觸、漏電、溫度與儀器限制；PCM 結構用於辨識製程參數，晶粒功能測試則回答產品是否完成指定功能。 本題具體操作為「在對數電流區挑選可信線性區間」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: Electrical tests control contact quality, leakage, temperature and instrument limits; PCM structures identify process parameters while functional tests evaluate product behavior. Here the concrete task is: Select a credible linear region in log-current data. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 次臨界擺幅量測的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for measure subthreshold swing
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「擬合區避開儀器底噪與強反轉」。但把底噪納入擬合會扭曲斜率；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: The fit avoids the noise floor and strong inversion. However, including the noise floor distorts slope; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「次臨界擺幅量測」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for measure subthreshold swing?
options: 擬合區避開儀器底噪與強反轉
串聯電阻及漏電影響先被檢查
結構性與功能性故障證據分開記錄
optionsEn: The fit avoids the noise floor and strong inversion
Series resistance and leakage effects are checked first
Structural and functional failure evidence is recorded separately
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「在對數電流區挑選可信線性區間」，因此直接證據是「擬合區避開儀器底噪與強反轉」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：把底噪納入擬合會扭曲斜率。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to select a credible linear region in log-current data; the direct criterion is: The fit avoids the noise floor and strong inversion. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: Including the noise floor distorts slope.

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate measure drain-induced barrier lowering by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: compare threshold extraction at two drain biases.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，比較兩種汲極偏壓下的閾值抽取。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, compare threshold extraction at two drain biases. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：閾值變化由相同方法與溫度取得。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: threshold shifts use the same method and temperature. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：偏壓與溫度同時改變會混淆原因。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: changing bias and temperature together confounds the cause. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「閾值變化由相同方法與溫度取得」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「偏壓與溫度同時改變會混淆原因」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Threshold shifts use the same method and temperature. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Changing bias and temperature together confounds the cause. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: FinFET 鰭寬與高度的證據與失效

knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「鰭寬與暴露高度分別量化」。但單一俯視尺寸不能代表通道總寬；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。

steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate assess finfet isolation recess by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: mark isolation height and exposed fin sidewalls.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，標示隔離層頂部與鰭側壁暴露範圍。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, mark isolation height and exposed fin sidewalls. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：有效鰭高與隔離功能同時滿足需求。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。

steps.failure: 診斷提醒：凹回過深可能增加不希望的寄生通道。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: excess recess can expose unwanted parasitic channels. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「有效鰭高與隔離功能同時滿足需求」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「凹回過深可能增加不希望的寄生通道」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Effective fin height and isolation requirements are both met. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Excess recess can expose unwanted parasitic channels. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

knowledge.title: 製程路線與結構證據交接的物理定位
knowledge.titleEn: Physical role of handoff route and structural evidence
knowledge.text: 本模組是互斥或可組合架構的比較分支：FinFET、GAA 與背面供電並非每條製程都同時存在；學習順序不等於實際晶圓行程。 本題具體操作為「把選用分支、剖面及材料標記綁定同一版本」，應先分辨施加的條件、實際量到的變量與推論出的性質。
knowledge.textEn: This module compares alternative or combinable architectures: FinFETs, GAA and backside power do not occur together in every flow. Learning order is not a wafer traveler. Here the concrete task is: Bind selected branches, sections and material labels to one revision. Distinguish imposed conditions, measured variables and inferred properties.

knowledge.title: 製程路線與結構證據交接的證據與失效
knowledge.titleEn: Evidence and failure modes for handoff route and structural evidence
knowledge.text: 有效證據需支持「交接圖與實際分支沒有互斥結構混搭」。但漂亮總圖可能包含未製作的分支；因此單一漂亮影像或平均值不能自動取代對本工序目標的檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence should establish the following: Handoff diagrams do not mix mutually exclusive structures. However, a polished overview may include unbuilt branches; an attractive image or a mean value cannot automatically substitute for a task-specific check.

quiz.question: 哪一項證據最直接支持「製程路線與結構證據交接」這一道教學工序的判定？
quiz.questionEn: Which evidence most directly supports acceptance for handoff route and structural evidence?
options: 層序與材料區分符合釋放路線
每片通道均具有連續源汲極連接
交接圖與實際分支沒有互斥結構混搭
optionsEn: Layer order and material identity match the release route
Each channel sheet has continuous source/drain connections
Handoff diagrams do not mix mutually exclusive structures
quiz.explanation: 本題操作是「把選用分支、剖面及材料標記綁定同一版本」，因此直接證據是「交接圖與實際分支沒有互斥結構混搭」。其他選項屬本模組其他工序，不能單獨取代此項檢查；另需留意：漂亮總圖可能包含未製作的分支。
quiz.explanationEn: The task is to bind selected branches, sections and material labels to one revision; the direct criterion is: Handoff diagrams do not mix mutually exclusive structures. The alternatives concern other operations and cannot alone replace this check. Also note: A polished overview may include unbuilt branches.

steps.routeNote: 教育順序；實際晶圓依選定製程分支、核准規格及合格設備行程執行。
steps.routeNoteEn: Educational ordering; actual wafers follow selected integration branches, approved specifications and qualified equipment travelers.

steps.title: 晶圓放行電性封存
steps.objective: 完成「晶圓放行電性封存」的證據判讀，辨識『核對 PCM、晶粒分級與可追溯測試版本』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate freeze wafer-release electrical evidence by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: reconcile pcm, die bins and traceable test revisions.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，核對 PCM、晶粒分級與可追溯測試版本。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, reconcile PCM, die bins and traceable test revisions. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：最終放行使用同一晶圓與有效版本結果。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: release uses the same wafer and valid result revisions. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：新舊測試混用會破壞放行可重現性。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: mixing revisions makes release decisions irreproducible. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「最終放行使用同一晶圓與有效版本結果」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「新舊測試混用會破壞放行可重現性」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: Release uses the same wafer and valid result revisions. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: Mixing revisions makes release decisions irreproducible. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.

steps.title: 良品晶圓製造交接
steps.objective: 完成「良品晶圓製造交接」的證據判讀，辨識『整合缺陷位置、封裝介面與未結案限制』所涉及的物理量與整合限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate handoff qualified wafers by identifying the physical quantities and integration limits involved in this task: combine defect locations, packaging interfaces and open restrictions.
steps.instruction: 以工程概念模型，或另行提供且已審查的示意截面／量測資料，整合缺陷位置、封裝介面與未結案限制。標出比較基準與量測位置並保留判讀依據；未掛接資料或未給允收數值時，標記定量驗證未完成，不自行編造機台參數。
steps.instructionEn: Using an engineering concept model, or a separately supplied and reviewed section or measurement dataset, combine defect locations, packaging interfaces and open restrictions. Mark the comparison baseline and measurement locations. If data or numerical acceptance limits are unavailable, mark quantitative validation incomplete rather than inventing tool settings.
steps.observation: 觀察與驗證重點：接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
steps.observationEn: Observation and validation target: the receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
steps.failure: 診斷提醒：只有合格標籤而無證據不足以交接。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
steps.failureEn: Diagnostic consideration: a pass label without evidence is insufficient for handoff. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
steps.check: 提交一項能支持「接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制」的標註圖或量測表；再指出「只有合格標籤而無證據不足以交接」會如何改變判讀。資料缺漏時保持未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit an annotated figure or measurement table supporting this criterion: The receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. Then explain the implication of this diagnostic caveat: A pass label without evidence is insufficient for handoff. Keep the task unreleased if evidence is missing.
